title: Cancel dipoles despite lone pairs
hints: Place the lone pairs opposite each other.
Add the dipoles of the four remaining bonds.
solution: $\ce{XeF4}$ is $AX_4E_2$, with an octahedral domain arrangement and a square-planar molecular shape. Opposite dipoles cancel.
statement:
Which geometry and polarity correctly describe $\ce{XeF4}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: The four identical Xe–F bond vectors cancel in opposing pairs.
Having lone pairs does not prevent symmetry in the occupied directions.
Six electron domains give an octahedral parent.
Seesaw has five domains and one lone pair.
